transcript.answer: No. Otto forbids it. FR-034 in the support-agent-tms-access spec says tool definitions registered in `apps/api` must not declare a customer id, company id or account number in their `inputSchema`. This applies at any depth and to English or Danish spellings. `registerTools` refuses such a definition before the registry holds it. Tests in `apps/api/test/customerBoundary.test.ts` check this. One test refuses a tool declaring `customerNumber`. Another refuses `orderer_customer_number` nested inside an array. A third walks every registered tool. ADR-001 gives the reason. The customer number is derived server-side from the authenticated identity (via the TMS scope resolver), and the model never supplies it. If a model-supplied customer id reaches a tool anyway, FR-033 says the TMS call uses the resolver's scope instead.

judgements.reason: The answer says no, covers any depth and English/Danish spellings, says registerTools refuses such definitions, and mentions a test that walks every registered tool, matching all essentials of the gold answer.
